notes.title: Patch 0.1.4b
notes.content: Sometimes games were not saved correctly and couldn't be loaded afterwards. We could not reproduce the bug, but found a fishy spot in our code which may produce corrupted savegames. Hopefully this patch will fix this problem.

notes.title: UPDATE Version 0.1.4
notes.content:
REPTRAILS 0.1.4 - New features, changes and bugfixes:

[list]
[*]Three difficulty levels
[*]Moving and zooming with keys
[*]15 Steam Achievements
[*]Dr. Steffen Humbug and Evelyn Blume
[*]Tooltips and help texts settings are now saved in the settings.nwo file
[*]Bugfix: Some help texts were not showing up
[*]Bugfix: Mainstream Media and Cell Towers were created twice in background under some circumstances
[*]Bugfix: Splashscreen volume is now set by the audio settings
[/list]

notes.title: REPTRAILS Early Access Release
notes.content: We will release REPTRAILS on Jun, the 26th. Hold your breath!
